#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

typedef long long llong;
#define sz(c) (int)(c).size()

llong gcd(llong a, llong b) {
    while( b )
        a%=b, swap(a,b);
    return a;
}

int main() {
    
    llong x, y, n; cin >> x >> y >> n;
    
    llong ansA, ansB;
    double dif = 1e12;
    for(llong b = 1; b <= n; b++) {
        llong l = 0, r = 100*1000;  
        llong a = 0;
        while( l <= r ) {
            llong mid = (l+r)>>1;
            if( mid*y <= x*b )
                a = mid, l = mid+1;
            else
                r = mid-1;
        }
        l = 0, r = 100*1000;
        llong aa = 0, bb = b;
        while( l <= r ) {
            llong mid = (l+r)>>1;
            if( mid*y < x*b )
                l = mid+1;
            else
                aa = mid, r = mid-1;
        }
        double curDif2 = abs(double(aa)/double(bb) - double(x)/double(y));
        double curDif1 = abs(double(a)/double(b) - double(x)/double(y));
        if( curDif2 + 1e-8 < curDif1) 
            a = aa, b = bb, curDif1 = curDif2;
        llong curGcd = gcd(a,b);
        if( curDif1 < dif )
            ansA = a/curGcd, ansB = b/curGcd, dif = curDif1;
    }
    
    cout << ansA << "/" << ansB;
    
    return 0;
}
